newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real slips 0.01 pct on higher dlr inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real slips 0.01 pct on higher dlr inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real slipped 0.01 percent to end at 1.0276 per dollar amid high dollar inflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.

Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Tuesday surplus of around $100 million. The Central Bank bought dollars in late afternoon at 1.0275 per greenback, maintaining the mini-band and draining excess dollars from the market, traders said.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real ended steady at 1.0331 to the dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.46 percent to close at 1.085 per greenback due to an excess supply of dollars in the market, traders said.
